description: One GET of {baseUrl}/logs/{bootstrapLogId}/{logId}/entries/{contentHash}, where contentHash is the hex sha256 of the signed statement bytes. Returns pending (with retryAfterMs when the server said so) or the receipt's URL, which includes the massif height, and the entry id. pending is the operator's answer for any content hash its sequencing index does not hold yet, including one that was never registered: the operator does not distinguish the two, so a retry only helps for a statement you know was submitted. receipt-available is the index's answer, not proof the receipt is written: fetch_receipt is the check, and a 404 there is not_found, never pending. Never polls: call again yourself if you want to. Provenance: fetched. Supports: none of the four questions; this is registration status.

baseUrl.description: any SCRAPI base URL; falls back to FORESTRIE_BASE_URL when omitted — never defaulted by the package itself

bootstrapLogId.description: UUID (with dashes), or a 16/32-byte hex log id; sent to the operator in UUID form

contentHash.description: hex sha256 of the signed statement bytes

logId.description: UUID (with dashes), or a 16/32-byte hex log id; sent to the operator in UUID form

name: query_registration
title: Query registration status
